schema.meta: run provenance: dates, universe parameters, bootstrap settings, and the parity check against morning_flush_continuation.json
schema.labels: label_key -> {question, definition, decision} — what each label asks in the trader's terms
schema.base_rates: base_rates[label][bucket_family][bucket] -> {n, k, p, ci_lo, ci_hi, n_days}. bucket_family is one of 'all' | 'move_age' | 'session_clock'. p is the point base rate; ci_* is a 95 % day-block bootstrap percentile interval.
schema.auc: auc[label][predictor] -> {auc, auc_day_median, n_days_scored, n_pos, n_neg}. Predictors are the program's nine traces, the two convergence scores, and four trivial baselines. All oriented so higher = predicts the positive class; AUC below .50 means the orientation is backwards on that label.
schema.score_conditional: flat list of {score, score_value, label, bucket_family, bucket, n, k, p, ci_lo, ci_hi, n_days} — P(label) jointly conditioned on convergence score and clock. This is the meter lookup.
schema.outcome_split: outcome_split[barriered_label][bucket_family][bucket] -> {n, p_target_first, p_stop_first, p_neither, pts_per_attempt, pts_ci_lo, pts_ci_hi}. Separates the two ways a barriered label can be False. pts_per_attempt is a frictionless first-order sanity number, not a backtest.
schema.excursions: distribution of the 15-minute favourable excursion (mfe), adverse excursion (mae) and mark-out (ret15) in SPX points, measured from each minute's close.
schema.parity: audit-report numbers this run reproduces: {expected, got}.

orig_ext2_beyond_standing_extreme.question: Will the move print a NEW extreme 2 pts past its high-water mark?
orig_ext2_beyond_standing_extreme.definition: price extends >= 2.0 pts beyond the extreme standing at t, within 15 min (the program's original label, morning_flush_continuation.py:152)
orig_ext2_beyond_standing_extreme.decision: breakout re-entry trigger; NOT what a position holder asks

reach2_any_adverse.question: From here, does price gain 2 pts my way within 15 min?
reach2_any_adverse.definition: max favourable excursion from the close of minute t >= 2 pts within 15 min; adverse path ignored
reach2_any_adverse.decision: target-only view; ignores what the position endures first

reach2_before_adverse4.question: Does price pay 2 pts before it takes 4 out of me, within 15 min?
reach2_before_adverse4.definition: first tick reaching +2 pts from the close of minute t arrives before the first tick reaching -4 pts; resolved on the raw tick stream
reach2_before_adverse4.decision: THE decision: target vs stop, in path order

fav_exceeds_adverse.decision: balanced framing with no threshold; audit report §3.1 row 5
